incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — reserved-pool eu-west-1 (pool-12) GPU pressure > 95% for 7m, average queue length 480 requests, autoscaler attempted scale but hit cap. Paging @oncall
Alice M (oncall): ack. I'm on it, joining call in 2.
Ben SRE: I see large sustained reservations from tenant=velvetbank-prod, 38/40 reserved GPUs in pool-12 are consumed by their jobs. Autoscaler config max_instances=40, but our layer above has instance_quota=40 so can't grow. Queue growth starting ~09:12 UTC.
Carla Eng: @Alice any evidence of noisy-worker loops from VelvetBank? their tasks look like repeated inference batches causing KV cache pressure.
Alice M (oncall): attaching quick logs
Alice M (oncall): ```
autoscaler: scale_attempt { target: 42 attempted: 40 reason: "pool_utilization>0.9" error: "instance_quota_exceeded" }
reservations: velvetbank-prod 38 GPUs, other tenants 2 GPUs
queue: avg_wait_ms=22000, inflight=1200, dropped=34
``` 
David C-Ops: We're getting support tickets from VelvetBank reporting high latency and 503s — contacting them but do not want force-restarts without CS approval.
Eve Sales: FYI I'm on the line with their infra lead. They report spikes from nightly batch job started ~08:50 UTC.
Ben SRE: Mitigation options:
- option A: apply per-tenant throttling (rate-limit VelvetBank to reduce reservation churn)
- option B: evict some non-enterprise low-priority reservations (preemptible) to free capacity
- option C: emergency bump quota for pool-12 (requires infra quota exec; 15-30m)
- option D: failover VelvetBank to hosted fallback region (eu-central) if model compatibility ok
Alice M (oncall): immediate step: apply soft throttling to velvetbank-prod at routing layer to cap concurrency to 8 workers. Doing now.
Alice M (oncall): `/run route update --tenant velvetbank-prod --concurrency 8` (executed)
incident-bot: command executed by Alice M: route update accepted, new concurrency=8
Ben SRE: after throttling, queue length dropped from 480 -> 210 in 6m. Inflight reduced, but still above SLO. We should evict preemptible tenants next.
Carla Eng: list of preemptible candidates: staging-team, integration-tests, lowpri-batch. Recommend evicting lowpri-batch first (they're at 3 reserved GPUs).
Alice M (oncall): evicting lowpri-batch now with preempt policy
Alice M (oncall): `evict --pool pool-12 --tenant lowpri-batch --force --reason "incident mitigation"`
incident-bot: eviction job queued, progress: 1/3 nodes drained
Ben SRE: also hitting a scaling race: autoscaler is configured with cooldown=30s and we have multiple concurrent scale attempts hitting quota. Need to pause autoscaler to avoid flapping while we resolve.
Alice M (oncall): pausing autoscaler for pool-12. `autoscaler pause --pool pool-12 --reason incident` (done)
David C-Ops: VelvetBank says they can delay their nightly job by 1 hour if we coordinate — offers to throttle on their side.
Eve Sales: Getting commitment from their infra: will flip a throttle flag in 5m. That's good for medium-term.
Ben SRE: current status: reserved usage 76% after eviction & throttles, queue avg_wait_ms 6200, drop rate down to 6. No customer-facing error spikes beyond minor 503s earlier.
Alice M (oncall): starting a short-term fix: create a temporary per-tenant reservation cap to prevent single tenant from consuming >50% of pool
Alice M (oncall): `config set pool-12 tenant_cap=0.5` (applied)
Carla Eng: note: tenant_cap is an emergency guard; we should document and revert after incident.
Ben SRE: next steps before unpause autoscaler:
- confirm VelvetBank has paused heavy job (confirmed by Eve)
- increase pool quota request to 50 instances (submit to infra ops)
- collect logs for postmortem (include autoscaler errors and reservation timeline)
Alice M (oncall): submitted infra quota request ticket #INC-98721 -> infra-ops. Marking P0 until quota resolved.
incident-bot: PAGER DUTY: escalation to oncall-sre happened at 09:18 UTC
pager-duty: oncall escalation confirmed to rotation +1
David C-Ops: Customer impact: VelvetBank had degraded latency for ~28m, some 503s during spike window. CS to open RCA with them — we should offer 1 week of credits for SLO miss.
Eve Sales: noted. I'll draft a statement and coordinate credits after postmortem.
Ben SRE: after 22m total mitigation, pool stabilized. Autoscaler remains paused; will only unpause after infra quota increase or manual checks.
Carla Eng: action items (triage):
- [ ] run eval on VelvetBank's batch job to recommend batching/packing improvements (Carla)
- [ ] add tenant-level reservation guard as permanent config (Ben)
- [ ] improve autoscaler quota-failure handling to fallback to routing throttles instead of repeatedly attempting scale (Alice)
- [ ] customer-facing summary and credits (Eve + David)
Alice M (oncall): closing incident channel for live operations; keeping thread open for postmortem notes. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
